description: Phone extraction must read what a page DECLARES, not what its machinery happens to look like. A subsetted @font-face unicode-range and an inline build string both produce hyphen-separated digit runs that satisfy the phone regex AND its punctuation guard — on a Framer/Wix/Squarespace site that is a dozen phantom contact numbers, and a phone is a reverse-WHOIS pivot, so each one spends credits chasing a font. The fix drops <script>/<style> BODIES before scanning visible text; this case also guards the regression that fix can cause, since schema.org JSON-LD lives inside a <script> and is often the only place a real number appears as text.
